# AMC Holo Edge

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Region Template** for Universal Theme · direction: bold · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A holographic foil edge and header strip built from the theme palette, with a sheen that shifts with the pointer or drifts slowly, around a calm, plain body.

**Use it for:** Premium or celebratory regions: a membership or entitlement Form, a rewards Cards region, a year-in-review Chart or a Static Content announcement; also a single featured Classic Report.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_holo_edge.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/region-templates/amc-holo-edge.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

On any region, set **Appearance > Template** to **AMC Holo Edge**. In APEXlang: `appearance { template: @amc-holo-edge }`.

Region template with a holographic foil edge and header strip. The foil is a repeating gradient of the theme palette colors, softened toward the surface color so the title stays readable; a fine diagonal texture and a glint sit on top. The sheen follows the mouse over the region and drifts slowly otherwise; keyboard focus shifts it as well. The body is a plain surface. Help, Edit, Change, Copy, Delete and Create buttons sit in the header, Previous, Close and Next in the footer. Template options thicken the edge, switch to a brand foil in primary and info tones or a sunset foil in danger and warning tones, stop the drift, or remove the body padding. Without JavaScript the foil still drifts; under reduced motion it stays still. In forced-colors mode the foil is replaced by a system border.

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Thick edge | `amc-THoloEdge--thick` | A 5px foil edge and a taller header strip, for a single hero region. |
| Brand foil | `amc-THoloEdge--brand` | Foil in primary and info tones only, for on-brand pages. |
| Sunset foil | `amc-THoloEdge--sunset` | Warm foil from the danger, warning and primary palette colors. |
| Static foil | `amc-THoloEdge--static` | Stops the slow drift; the sheen moves only with the pointer. |
| No body padding | `amc-THoloEdge--noPadding` | Removes side padding so reports run edge to edge. |
